mentions.name: Copeland TS
mentions.description: A TypeScript-style language for .NET with full NuGet and NPM interop, Rust-style exhaustive `match`, and templates. It compiles to JavaScript, C#, WebAssembly via Blazor WebAssembly, and SPIR-V via HLSL/DXC, running on V8 for JS and RyuJIT/NativeAOT for C#. It also ships with a full UI layout system, a Vulkan renderer, and a game/app runtime that are still rough; benchmarking found RyuJIT roughly 2x faster than V8 JS in hot loops but with higher cold-start time.
mentions.problem: Provides TypeScript-style development for .NET without the weirdness of JavaScript.
mentions.author: YuechenLi
